title: Kapoori Empties as the Campaign Turns to Samana

blocks.text: More contingents, goods, and helpers reach Banda, and the countryside shifts around him as places like Kapoori empty or realign in fear of what is coming.
The page then opens toward Samana, where the march of Banda and the Singhs will soon become direct assault instead of preparation.
By naming Kapoori within this build-up, the text shows how the mere approach of the Khalsa can dislocate local order before battle even begins.
